title: Lamb and Kenyan Tagine
description: A unique blend of Mexican and African flavors in this hearty lamb tagine recipe. The piquant spice mix adds a tangy twist to this traditional dish.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb shoulder on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb and set aside.
Add more oil if needed, then sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the tomato, chili flakes, and tagine spice blend. Cook for 2 minutes.
Return the lamb to the pot and add the piquant spice mix.
Pour in enough water to cover the lamb and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2-3 hours or until lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
